none: PAS NLM-A06932: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Roman Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19, Trier mint. Obverse description: Diademed bust draped right. Obverse inscription: [--]VALENT[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SEC]V[RITAS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: TRP. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin, noting it is chipped. Diameter: 14.2mm, Weight: 1.00gms, die axis: 6
